sloka: दन्तैः भुजाभ्यां पद्मां च शक्तितोमरसायकैः ।येन केनैव संरब्धस्ताडयामास वै सुरान् ।। ७.२८.३५ ॥
transliteration: dantaiḥ bhujābhyāṁ padmāṁ ca śaktitomarasāyakaiḥ ।yena kenaiva saṁrabdhastāḍayāmāsa vai surān ।। 7.28.35 ॥

translations.english: Enraged, he indeed struck the gods with teeth, with two arms, a lotus, and with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, by whatever means possible.
